title: Timeline semaphore synchronization for shell TLAS rebuilds implemented
implementation_summary: Created VkSemaphore with VK_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_TIMELINE for TLAS rebuild coordination
Added monotonic counter tracking (m_shellBuildCounter) for stage progression
Implemented buildShellBLASWithSync() and updateShellTLASWithSync() with timeline semaphore
Added host-side semaphore wait in MeshParticleRenderer before binding shell TLAS
Integrated debug logging for timeline value tracking and synchronization verification

Added timeline semaphore wait logic using vkWaitSemaphores

Added static lastWaitedValue to avoid redundant waits
Enhanced debug logging to show timeline values and wait status
